g.text: Open a listing (REQ-005-1/5/7)
An earlier address of a listing that was moved
to another region forwards to its current
address first (REQ-005-6).
Anyone, logged in or not, opens a public
listing address: region + listing slug
A Draft, a Pending approval and a Rejected
listing have no public address at all.
An address built from a listing's id is not found.
Not found — the same page as for
an address that never existed
no
Was a listing ever published
at this address?
yes
Status now
Only the status decides. A Published listing
is shown whatever its region (active or hidden)
and whatever the owner's role is now.
Show the public page
The same words for both, so the public cannot
tell a take-down from a close. No reason is shown.
The owner and Admins are no exception:
they see this page too, with their link.
Show "This job is no longer listed." and a link
to the jobs in its region. Nothing from the listing
is shown. The page is answered as "gone"
Add the link to the owner view
or to the Admin view (REQ-005-10)
yes
Viewer is the owner or an Admin?
no
Offer the way back, first on the page:
"Jobs in <region>", always the listing's own region
The listing as it is now, an Admin's edits included.
The business name and "about" are the listing's own copy.
Title, business name
Trust line: "✓ Approved", "Posted" with the time
of approval (relative under 7 days, a date after),
and the region
Facts: salary range per month, location
(area and region), type, schedule if given
Never shown: the poster's email address,
who approved it, any status label.
Sections: About the job, Requirements and Benefits
if given, About <business> if given
Offer "Share" (REQ-005-8)
Say "Applying through jairojobs is coming soon."
There is no Apply button until spec 007
Add the link to the owner view
or to the Admin view (REQ-005-10)
yes
Viewer is the owner or an Admin?
no
Published
Closed or
Taken down
